info.longName: State Street My2032 Corporate Bond ETF

funds_data.description: Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund’s net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2032, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
